content: संभू €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To arise, to be born or produced, spring up; कथमपि भुवनेऽस्मिस्तादृशाः संभवन्ति <ls>Māl. 2. 9</ls>; धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे <ls>Bg. 4. 8</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 22</ls>; <ls>Bk. 6. 138</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 155</ls>. .²2 To be, become, exist. .²3 To happen, occur, take place. .²4 To be possible. .²5 To be adequate for, be competent for (with <ab>inf.</ab>); न यन्नियन्तुं समभावि भानुना <ls>Śi. 1. 27</ls>. .²6 To meet, be united or joined with; संभूयाम्भोधिमभ्येति महानद्या नगापगा <ls>Śi. 2. 100</ls>; संभूयेव सुखानि चेतसि <ls>Māl. 5. 9</ls>, <ls n="Māl. 5.">18</ls>. .²7 To be consistent. .²8 To have sexual intercourse with; तां समभवत्ततो मनुष्या अजायन्त <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 4. 3</ls>; महर्षिः संविदं कृत्वा संबभूव तया सह <ls>Mb. 1. 178. 44</ls>. .²9 To be capable of existing in, be contained in. .²10 To attain to. .²11 To partake of. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To produce, effect, make. .²2 To imagine, conceive, fancy, think. .²3 To guess or conjecture; <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²4 To consider, regard. .²5 To honour, respect, esteem, show respect to; प्राप्तोऽसि संभावयितुं वनान्माम् <ls>R. 5. 11</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 8</ls>. .²9 To honour or present with, treat with; अर्धोपभुक्तेन बिसेन जायां संभावयामास रथाङ्गनामा <ls>Ku. 3. 37</ls>. .²7 To ascribe or impute to; पापं कर्म च यत् परैरपि कृतं तत्तस्य संभाव्यते <ls>Mk. 1. 36</ls>. .²8 To come or go to, approach. .²9 To take part in, enjoy; <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²10 To greet, salute. .²11 To manifest, exhibit. .²12 To expect. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} of {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To be possible; कथमेतद्भवति संभाव्यते <ls>Ś. 2</ls>.
